Docs / Reference

Repository file catalog

Generated by scripts/docs-reference.mjs. This inventories maintained public source families, including skill references and verifiers. Local state, dependencies, private evidence, generated vendor code, and curated screenshot binaries are excluded; see the resource model for those families.

How to find a change

Start with the feature map, search this catalog for the module or concept, then read the source and matching verifier. A file description explains its role; it does not replace its contract. Regenerate after adding or removing source files.
